_note: Original to Arda. Written for this project; not taken from any published table.

traits.text: Greets everyone by name and expects the same courtesy back.
Cannot bear to eat alone and will drag a stranger to the table.
Answers questions with as few words as will do.
Keeps the shutters closed and personal business closer still.
Flares up fast, then apologises twice as fast.
Has seen floods, fires and tax collectors, and shrugs at all three.
Will wait out any argument, any queue and any winter.
Finds a bright side in bad harvests and says so, loudly.
Plans for next year as if it is certain to be better.
Expects rain, and is quietly pleased when it comes.
Counts the change twice and the stranger's friends three times.
Every tool has a hook, and every hook has a tool on it.
Arrives before the bell and scowls at those who arrive after it.
Loses a thing, finds two others, forgets what was lost.
Lets tomorrow's chores worry about themselves.
Steps forward first when something needs doing, sensible or not.
Once a mind is made up it stays that way, whatever the cost.
Checks the ice, the ladder and the deal before trusting any of them.
Would rather lose an argument than start one.
Always has a spare crust, a spare coin or a spare bed.
Remembers the birthdays of half the street's children.
Says exactly what everyone else is only thinking.
Is polite to everyone and close to no one.
Asks travellers about every road they have walked.
Is forever improving a tool that already worked fine.
Does things the way a grandparent did them, and says why.
Has never been further than the next market and sees no reason to.
Plays small pranks and laughs hardest when they backfire.
Has a sharp remark ready for every occasion, kind or otherwise.
Takes every joke at face value and every promise to heart.
Smiles rarely, and people remember when it happens.
Mentions an ancestor's great deed at least once a day.
Owns one fine garment and wears it whatever the weather.
Deflects praise onto whoever is standing nearest.
Apologises for things that were never anyone's fault.

ideals.name: Devotion
ideals.short: serves the gods in every small task
ideals.text: The gods watch the small tasks most closely.

ideals.name: Ritual
ideals.short: keeps every rite and feast day
ideals.text: A rite kept exactly is a promise kept to the gods.

ideals.name: Mercy
ideals.short: believes no one is past saving
ideals.text: No one is so far gone that a kind hand cannot reach them.

ideals.name: Charity
ideals.short: gives what can be spared and a bit more
ideals.text: What I can spare belongs to whoever needs it more.

ideals.name: Community
ideals.short: puts the town before the self
ideals.text: The town stands or falls together, so I stand with it.

ideals.name: Duty
ideals.short: does the job even when no one checks
ideals.text: A task accepted is a task finished, watched or not.

ideals.name: Order
ideals.short: trusts rules more than people
ideals.text: Good rules outlast good intentions.

ideals.name: Protection
ideals.short: stands between the town and harm
ideals.text: Someone has to stand at the gate, so it may as well be me.

ideals.name: Honour
ideals.short: would rather lose than cheat
ideals.text: A victory won by a lie is a defeat that takes longer.

ideals.name: Craft
ideals.short: wants to make one perfect thing
ideals.text: Work done well is its own kind of prayer.

ideals.name: Tradition
ideals.short: keeps the old ways alive
ideals.text: Our grandparents' ways kept us alive this long.

ideals.name: Prosperity
ideals.short: means to leave the children richer
ideals.text: A full purse is a roof that never leaks.

ideals.name: Fair Dealing
ideals.short: prizes an honest measure
ideals.text: A true scale is worth more than a heavy one.

ideals.name: Ambition
ideals.short: means to be more than this
ideals.text: I was not born to stay where I was born.

ideals.name: Freedom
ideals.short: answers to no lord gladly
ideals.text: No lord owns the sky over my field.

ideals.name: Independence
ideals.short: relies on no one
ideals.text: What I cannot do myself I will learn to do.

ideals.name: Knowledge
ideals.short: wants to understand how things work
ideals.text: Every question answered is a lamp lit.

ideals.name: Family
ideals.short: lives for the family
ideals.text: Blood first, then friends, then everyone else.

ideals.name: Kinship with the Land
ideals.short: listens to the soil and the seasons
ideals.text: The land gives back what we give it, and no more.

ideals.name: Power
ideals.short: wants others to need their favour
ideals.text: People who need you do what you ask.

ideals.name: Greed
ideals.short: never has enough
ideals.text: Enough is a word for people who have stopped trying.

ideals.name: Reason Before Faith
ideals.short: trusts evidence over any altar
ideals.text: The gods have never paid a debt or mended a roof.

ideals.name: Nonviolence
ideals.short: refuses to raise a hand against anyone
ideals.text: Every blade drawn cuts its owner too.

ideals.name: Pleasure
ideals.short: means to enjoy every day
ideals.text: Life is short; the ale should not be.

bonds.text: Would do anything for {kin}, even the foolish things.
Is saving every spare coin for a better life for {kin}.
Still hasn't forgiven {kin} for an old slight, but would die for them.
Owes everything to {workplace} and the people there.
Means to own {workplace} one day, or one just like it.
Takes pride in keeping {workplace} running through hard times.
Loves {settlement} more than any grander place could be loved.
Keeps a keepsake from a sweetheart who left {settlement} years ago.
Owes a quiet debt to a stranger who once passed through {settlement}.
Tends the grave of someone most of {settlement} has forgotten.
Swore an oath at the shrine as a youngster and has kept it ever since.
Wants {settlement} to remember their name after they are gone.
Believes the old tree by the road watches over {settlement}.
Once saw something in the woods and has never stopped looking for it.
Trusts {friend} more than family, and says so to anyone who listens.
Owes {friend} a favour that has not yet been called in.
Is determined to outdo {rival} in everything that matters.
Nurses a grudge against {rival} over a dispute nobody else remembers.

flaws.text: Drinks more than is wise when the day goes badly.
Cannot keep a secret past the next meal.
Remembers every slight and repays each one eventually.
Will spend an hour finding a way out of a ten-minute job.
Bets on anything: dice, weather, the speed of a snail.
Measures every blessing against a neighbour's.
Tells small lies out of habit, even when the truth is easier.
Runs first and explains later.
Assumes everyone else is a little slower.
Cannot pass up a coin, even one that is plainly not theirs.
Would rather be wrong for a year than admit it for a moment.
Takes the short way across the thin ice every time.
Will not start a task on a day with a bad omen.
Spends more on appearances than the purse allows.
Is sure every problem is someone else's fault.
Believes any story told with a straight face.
Wins arguments and loses friends.
Hides something shameful and fears it will come out.
Keeps things nobody could possibly need, just in case.
Distrusts anyone not born within sight of the town.
Cannot wait for anything, not even bread to cool.
Will agree to almost anything if it comes with praise.

mannerisms: Hums the same four notes over and over.
Taps a finger on the table while thinking.
Speaks very softly, forcing listeners to lean in.
Laughs a beat too late at every joke.
Uses a grand word wrongly and proudly.
Chews on a stalk of straw or a pipe stem.
Scratches the back of the neck when unsure.
Always speaks of the weather first.
Calls everyone 'friend', including enemies.
Repeats the last word someone else said.
Squints as if the sun were always in their eyes.
Counts things under their breath: coins, steps, birds.
Rubs their hands together before any task.
Talks with their hands, knocking over cups.
Clicks their tongue in disapproval.
Quotes a long-dead grandparent's sayings.
Pauses mid-sentence to stare at nothing.
Wipes their hands on an apron that is never clean.
Adds 'mark my words' to every prediction.
Whistles through a gap in their teeth.
Never sits with their back to a door.
Speaks of themselves in the third person when proud.
Offers snacks from a pocket that seems bottomless.
Bows slightly too low to anyone of rank.
Winks after saying anything important.
Clears their throat before every sentence.
Keeps glancing at the sky as if expecting something.
Fiddles with a ring or a charm on a cord.
